verdict.rationale: Cactus does have a cloud-offload path: the engine routes hard queries to the cloud based on local model confidence (gh-3), so this axis applies. However, the documented plans, prices, and billing limits all cover hosted fine-tuning and training: /v1/plans lists fine-tuning prices, the Starter/Pro/Custom tiers sell hosted GPUs and full-model training, and GET /billing reports allowance for training jobs. No evidence documents pricing tiers, rate limits, or usage caps for cloud inference offload.
